features.categoryNames: Original site labels, surrounding whitespace trimmed and exact duplicates only
features.dynamicMenus: Literal metadata first, bounded visible-page native parsing, successful complete menus published incrementally; lifecycle cancellation; no source health checks
features.lists: Recycled horizontal category views, incremental snapshots and loaded results retained
features.queuedMenus: Only an acquired request slot counts as an attempt; queued sources remain pending
features.coldStart: Initialize Rhino before entering the first coroutine script context
features.data: No rewrite of source rules/groups, books, reading progress, bookmarks or history; existing 1.2.4 original source restore pack remains compatible

handset.installationMethod: User installs from existing in-app update channel

knownLimitations: No handset installation or manual TalkBack acceptance claimed
Unavailable menus may time out without erasing earlier successful results; no website-availability claim
